pricing.title: Choose your pace, with no hidden price.
pricing.intro: Free includes three free credits each week. An optional video can add credits; Premium removes ads and the weekly limit.
pricing.notice: These prices come from the API’s current catalogue. Subscription purchases and payments will be enabled with the app’s commercial launch.

free.name: Free
free.description: Three credits every Monday at 00:00 UTC, without rollover. Each Free participant spends their own credit after both people agree.

premium.name: Premium
premium.description: No ads or credits to spend, with unlimited continuations. Both people must still agree.

features.rewardedCredits: 1 credit per optional video · up to {stock} stored
features.weeklyLimit: Up to {count} confirmed continuations each week
